summary: Frontend-only regression + $-Codes/GodMode functional testing. All 7 requested flows exercised via mobile viewport (390x844) Playwright. Home CODES_LAB EXECUTE plays 432Hz (measured 433.4Hz, scope 25%); STOP returns to STBY. '$ CODES' chip toggles to '$ GODMODE' — with playback live, scope meta line reads 'BEAT 7.8 Hz SYNC' and iframe canvas pixel scan at y=0-25 shows gold(9)+teal(16)+white(6) pixels confirming I·POTENTIAL / II·BIOFIELD / III·COHERENCE field labels lighting sequentially. Toggling god OFF while playing keeps audio alive (chip back to '$ CODES', 25% level, STOP still visible — live-rebuild works, no silence/crash). SCLR chip toggles ◇↔◈, +/- steppers work (7.83→9.79→7.83). CODES ARCHIVE modal shows STANDARD/'$-CODES · GODMODE' tier row, gold-fill activates, 'SCALAR-AUGMENTED · DUAL-DDS ±3.92Hz SIDEBANDS · AM BURST 7.83Hz · OPPOSED-COIL FIELD' meta visible, entries carry '$ ' name prefix in A-Z view. /library tier row present, ▶ starts (9% scope) and ◼ stops. /binaural INITIATE plays 432Hz carrier (measured 431.9Hz, 25%), TERMINATE stops. Two non-blocking issues observed: (1) canvas 'arc' negative-radius pageerror on /binaural, (2) library entries do NOT gain '$ ' name prefix when $-CODES tier is selected (archive modal DOES apply it — inconsistent). Deprecated: expo-av (Expo SDK 54).

ui_bugs.issue: PAGEERROR: Failed to execute 'arc' on 'CanvasRenderingContext2D': The radius provided (-6.08) is negative. Likely a beat-pulse or orb radius calculation that goes negative when scalar/god settings interact with binaural view. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ScopeNodePanel.tsx (drawOrb / drawFields / drawCymascope beatPulse math).

When $-CODES tier is selected on /library the entry names are NOT prefixed with '$ ' (archive modal does apply the prefix correctly). Inconsistent tier presentation. Reference: /app/frontend/app/library.tsx.

issues: No testID props on any TouchableOpacity/Pressable/TextInput. Tests had to rely on brittle text selectors (e.g. 'EXECUTE', 'SCLR', 'PLAY'). Add testIDs for: godChip, execBtn, sclrChip, sclrPlus, sclrMinus, archiveOpen, archiveTierStd, archiveTierGod, libraryTierStd, libraryTierGod, binauralInitiate, binauralTerminate.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated package in use — will be removed in SDK 54. Migrate to expo-audio (audio) and expo-video (video). Console warning fires on every page load. Reference: /app/frontend/package.json (expo-av dependency).
'TouchableMixin is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' console warning — old react-native Touchable* wrapper is somewhere in tree (likely a third-party package).
'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated on web — should be migrated to 'boxShadow' / 'textShadow' shorthand where possible.

Unknown event handler property: onStartShouldSetResponder / onResponderTerminationRequest / onResponderGrant / onResponderMove / onResponderRelease / onResponderTerminate — these RN-native touch responder props leak to the DOM on web preview (React warnings). Guard with Platform.OS !== 'web' or use PanResponder.web-safe wrappers.

action_items: Fix negative-radius canvas.arc bug on /binaural (guard radius with Math.max(0, r) in drawOrb / beatPulse-modulated size calcs in ScopeNodePanel.tsx).
Apply '$ ' name prefix to library.tsx entries when godMode is on to match CODES ARCHIVE modal behaviour.
Add testID props on all interactive elements listed under design_issues to make future automated testing robust.
Suppress or Platform-gate RN touch-responder props on web preview to eliminate the six React warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: AudioEngine.tsx is 1200+ lines mixing WebView-HTML bridge + web implementations + provider component. Consider splitting into audioBridgeHtml.ts, audioEngineWeb.ts, audioEngineNative.ts, AudioBridgeProvider.tsx for maintainability.

AudioEngine.tsx duplicates the full generator chain (godMode, oscs, binaural, soundscape, media) once in the WebView HTML string and once in web* functions — any change must be made twice; risk of divergence is high.
ScopeNodePanel.tsx PANEL_HTML is 860+ lines of embedded JS inside a template literal — no lint coverage. Consider externalising and injecting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home page CODES_LAB is below the hero — scroll ~6 wheel ticks. Use text selectors (no testIDs): 'EXECUTE'/'STOP' regex '[▶ EXECUTE]|[■ STOP]', chip '$ CODES'/'$ GODMODE', 'SCLR 7.83', 'CODES ARCHIVE', '$-CODES · GODMODE'. Scope % lives in headerBar state pill (regex '\d+%'). Measured Hz appears after '→' in header. Canvas iframe field-label pixels can be sampled via page.evaluate on iframe.contentDocument canvas (top 25px band, look for gold RGB(255,215,94)/teal RGB(61,255,171)/white). To confirm binaural: /binaural page has INITIATE/TERMINATE with a full CymaScope panel that currently throws negative-radius canvas.arc error.
rca_of_issue: Binaural canvas error RCA: 'The radius provided (-6.08) is negative' fires inside ScopeNodePanel.tsx PANEL_HTML. Most likely source is beatPulse math in drawFields()/drawCymascope() (`R*0.30*beatPulse` etc.) or drawOrb size×intensity when livePeak spikes negative on binaural (which uses stereo channels — the mono analyser tap can report edge values). Repro: navigate to /binaural → click INITIATE → observe pageerror in console within ~1-2s. Mitigation: wrap every ctx.arc(..., r, ...) with `Math.max(0.001, r)` and clamp pR/geomR/r3/mr computations to >=0.
